summary: Launch details select one session before rendering instead of rendering the launch collection.

schema.detail: Uses existing session, candidate, preview, subject and desired primary-key indexes; no database schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, authority or retention rules change.

compatibility.detail: Preserves native-ID precedence, public-ID fallback, historical visibility and all launch fields. Item and envelope now use one pinned read. Detail explicitly requires read.projections for GET and HEAD; GET admission already required it. Preview declarations use selected keys with the same candidate-intent overlay. Collections, cursors, error codes and payload admission limits are unchanged. Selected-session history, variants and document payload costs remain; no bounded whole-request bytes or history-work claim.

recovery.detail: Read-only change; source data and writer behavior are preserved.
